AUTOMATED_RUNTIME.description: Wall-clock time of scripted pipeline steps executed in this phase.
AUTOMATED_RUNTIME.note: Machine time, not human time. Reported separately and never conflated.

HUMAN_ANALYST_ACTIVE_TIME.why: No human ran the review timer during Phase 4. Claude Code wall-clock time is NOT human analyst time and is never labelled as such. The AnalystTimer built in Phase 3 is available and tested; it produces a number only when a human actually starts and stops it.

TOOL_RUNTIME.description: Time spent inside external tools (GitHub API, curl, pytest, next build).
TOOL_RUNTIME.note: Captured incidentally in command output; not aggregated into a single figure.
